races.name: C J Cox Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
Woolley & Wallis Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
Friars Moor Livestock Health Handicap Hurdle
Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
races.verdict:
NESWICK proved suited by the step up in trip when making a winning start to life in handicaps at Southwell and can defy a 2 lb weights rise with likely better still to come from this lightly-raced sort. Wolverhampton scorer Fiefdom also has relatively few miles on the clock and is feared most, while the handily-weighted Percy Jones and C&D winner Fair Dinkum can also have a say in this intriguing handicap.

  1. NESWICK
  2. FIEFDOM (IRE)
  3. PERCY JONES

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery
races.verdict:
The 2 interesting ones PRIDE'S QUEEN and Hemustbeanangel are drawn on the outside, which isn't ideal, but they are still expected to come to the fore. Ready preference is for the Botti filly given her latest second can be upgraded quite a lot. Rocsane may keep on for a place.

  1. PRIDE'S QUEEN
  2. HEMUSTBEANANGEL (IRE)
  3. ROCSANE (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not a deep maiden so it could be worth chancing GREEN SPAIN, who didn't show masses on debut in France this summer but that was a pretty warm race and her pedigree and connections suggest she'll up her game. Uomo Valeroso showed enough starting out at Kempton to think he'll be involved, with Rhythm Runner, Gilded Outlaw and Sand On The Run interesting newcomers on paper.

  1. GREEN SPAIN
  2. UOMO VALEROSO (USA)
  3. RHYTHM RUNNER

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Nursery
races.verdict:
DEFIANT DREAM took a step forward when runner-up at Nottingham last time and is weighted to go one better and gain a first success off just a 1 lb higher mark here. Fancied Angel didn't enjoy the rub of the green when a recent fifth at Wolverhampton and is next on the list with likely better to come. Last Dandelion and Past Passion appeal also and need considering in this open nursery.

  1. DEFIANT DREAM
  2. FANCIED ANGEL
  3. LAST DANDELION

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
TRUSTINTIMES can call upon a very good strike rate and with this trip sure to suit on second Flat start, he can find the necessary improvement required to land this. Liam Mera Kai is a definite threat back on a left-handed track, with Rowlf another potential improver.

  1. TRUSTINTIMES
  2. LIAM MERA KAI (FR)
  3. ROWLF

races.name: ARC 1M Bonus Handicap
races.verdict:
A few of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with REY DE LA BATALLA, who hinted at a revival when fourth at Kempton last time and can race off a 1 lb lower mark now. In-form Valentine Boy could prove the chief threat, although Sant Alessio is also weighted to go well if back on song.

  1. REY DE LA BATALLA
  2. VALENTINE BOY
  3. SANT ALESSIO (IRE)

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
On the back of a fair return to action for new connections, TEGGY LASSO is fancied to take a step forward here with a raft of engagements in the coming days perhaps a sign of intent. Twitch is an in-form rival with a good draw to exploit, while Lessay is back at a much more realistic level.

  1. TEGGY LASSO (IRE)
  2. TWITCH (NZ)
  3. LESSAY (IRE)

races.name: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
TAM LIN shaped well after an absence on his first start for Mick Appleby when a recent Southwell fourth, fading only late on, and looks the way to go here with that run under his belt. C&D scorer Rovinia is next on the list, while in-form maiden Orange Emperor and multiple course winner Dandy Khan can also play a prominent role.

  1. TAM LIN (IRE)
  2. ROVINIA
  3. ORANGE EMPEROR (IRE)

races.name: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
James Owen looked to be finding the key to MERITOCRATIC before he was sent hurdling minus headgear and he's tentatively selected to shed his maiden status back on all-weather. Far Far Out is a solid rival, with Herstmonceux and Intsaar potential improvers.

  1. MERITOCRATIC (IRE)
  2. FAR FAR OUT (IRE)
  3. HERSTMONCEUX

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MEHMAR only just failed to justify sustained support starting out for his new yard when second at Southwell 31 days ago, splitting a pair of next-time-out winners in the process. He remains very well handicapped on the back of 4 lb rise based on past exploits and rates a major player from a handy draw. Black Missile also arrives on the back of a solid effort and is next best, whilst Knicks has the ability to play a part if putting it all together, too.

  1. MEHMAR (IRE)
  2. BLACK MISSILE (IRE)
  3. KNICKS (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PROSEWRITER did well under the circumstances and looked a good prospect to boot when making a winning debut in a Southwell novice 4 weeks ago. Well-bred and open to improvement, he may well be up to defying a penalty and go 2-2. Gombey Rhythm cost plenty at the breeze-ups last year and the booking of Billy Loughnane signals intent ahead of debut. Baandee and Flag of Nations complete the dangers.

  1. PROSEWRITER (IRE)
  2. GOMBEY RHYTHM
  3. BAANDEE

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ZAJAL hails from a fine family and showed plenty when chasing home one who is undoubtedly destined for pattern class in a Doncaster maiden on debut 32 days ago. He looks sure to progress and is fancied to confirm the promise of that run here. Manolin and Manitoba also shaped promisingly on debut and head up the dangers.

  1. ZAJAL
  2. MANOLIN
  3. MANITOBA

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
The betting will no doubt prove informative but MODERNIST fetched a lofty sum as a yearling and makes plenty of appeal for leading connections, so he could be the way to go under Colin Keane. Haldon Fire sets a good standard on his promising Southwell debut second and can put that experience to good use. Mythical Tale and Top Scholar are other likely-looking improvers following their respective opening effort.

  1. MODERNIST
  2. HALDON FIRE
  3. MYTHICAL TALE (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery (GBBPlusRace)
races.verdict:
NATIONAL PRIDE took a big step forward on his first venture into nursery company when an emphatic Chelmsford scorer and is fancied to make light of a 5 lb higher mark with this step up in distance a positive too. High Calibre is also weighted to have a say and rates next best ahead of nursery debutant Happy Love.

  1. NATIONAL PRIDE (IRE)
  2. HIGH CALIBRE
  3. HAPPY LOVE (GER)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
SILENT STRIKE got his career firmly back having been gelded during his 4-month absence when staying on late for third over C&D 5 weeks ago and, with that form worthy of viewing positively, certainly in relation to those in the frame, he could be worth chancing to build on that. Another Abbot, Dandana and Bolo Neighs head up the dangers in a good quality heat.

  1. SILENT STRIKE (IRE)
  2. ANOTHER ABBOT (IRE)
  3. DANDANA

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
ENOLA GREY has been shaping up well from her reduced mark and might prove the answer to this competitive fillies' handicap. Chantelle is another who has offered plenty of promise in her recent starts and is second choice ahead of Ghisa and Queen Tamara.

  1. ENOLA GREY (IRE)
  2. CHANTELLE
  3. GHISA (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
FLAGBEARER makes obvious appeal as an unexposed 3-y-o from a leading stable and he can make a successful start to his handicap career. Must Believe added to his strong record on all-weather when scoring at Chelmsford under Billy Loughnane 19 days ago and is second choice ahead of Codiak.

  1. FLAGBEARER
  2. MUST BELIEVE
  3. CODIAK (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but CAMPENAERTS is proving progressive for Jonathan Portman and is taken to make light of a 6 lb rise for his comfortable Nottingham success and bag a second C&D victory. In-form C&D winner Maharajas Express could emerge as the chief threat with Billy Loughnane in the saddle, although Rye and Sunlit Sea can also play a prominent role.

  1. CAMPENAERTS
  2. MAHARAJAS EXPRESS
  3. RYE

races.name: Join The Southwell Racecourse Corporate Club Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
IMPERIAL BEDE has plummeted to a career-low mark after a quiet spell and the cheekpieces he wore for the first time when last successful are back on. He's interesting for an in-form stable, all the more so if there is strength behind him in the betting. Grain Trade should stay this far and is a player, while last year's winner Bravethewaves could be a force in new headgear.

  1. IMPERIAL BEDE (FR)
  2. GRAIN TRADE
  3. BRAVETHEWAVES

races.name: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
SLEDGEHAMMER had a next-time-out winner behind him at Wetherby and is taken to defy the handicapper again and make it 3-3 since joining Adrian Keatley. Bells of Ufford made a promising start to his chasing career at Ffos Las and is second choice ahead of Kastellion and Could Be You.

  1. SLEDGEHAMMER (IRE)
  2. BELLS OF UFFORD (IRE)
  3. KASTELLION (FR)

races.name: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
BEAU DE MAINE showed plenty - behind one who's since run well over hurdles - in a Market Rasen bumper on his debut last month, so he's an appealing candidate making a quick switch to jumping for a yard that continues in fine fettle. Popton Point won 2 of her 3 starts in the bumper sphere last season, impressing with her attitude, and is surely up to making her presence felt on her hurdling debut, while Uda Man Dan is an interesting newcomer given his useful Flat pedigree.

  1. BEAU DE MAINE (FR)
  2. POPTON POINT (IRE)
  3. UDA MAN DAN (GER)

races.name: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MADE IN REUGNY was a big-money purchase after finishing second in a newcomers race at Compiegne last autumn and has been found an excellent opportunity to go one better on his UK/stable debut. Goodbye Earl and Campfield Flyer could be the pair to fill the places.

  1. MADE IN REUGNY (FR)
  2. GOODBYE EARL (IRE)
  3. CAMPFIELD FLYER

races.name: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NOBODY TOLD ME is selected to make a winning start for new trainer Dan Skelton, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Yourcardismarked has also been the subject of an interesting trainer change and support for him would make him a potentially dangerous opponent. Laplander should be up to doing something off this mark based on Flat ability, while it would also be no surprise were Cheap Sandwiches to prove a different proposition in handicaps.

  1. NOBODY TOLD ME
  2. YOURCARDISMARKED (IRE)
  3. LAPLANDER

races.name: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
IN THE PURPLE hasn't been seen since a C&D handicap success in February but he took that in the style of one who should have more to offer for a leading stable. The Boss Bear couldn't justify favouritism but still made a sound start for the James Owen yard at Plumpton 3 weeks ago and heads the many possible dangers along with Presenting Milan and Dan Skelton's Typhoon Warrior, who is bred to be suited by this longer trip.

  1. IN THE PURPLE (IRE)
  2. THE BOSS BEAR (IRE)
  3. PRESENTING MILAN (IRE)

races.name: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GIMARIAS is the obvious one on the back of his good second to a progressive sort at Chepstow at the beginning of the month. The fact that The Brave Guy went off as short as 5/2 in a competitive race on his handicap debut suggests he's thought better than he showed on that occasion. The low-mileage Elusive Shine is one to monitor closely in the betting on his return from an absence for in-form Sam England.

  1. GIMARIAS (IRE)
  2. THE BRAVE GUY (IRE)
  3. ELUSIVE SHINE (IRE)

races.name: Conferences And Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WILD GOOSE has been in good form this autumn and gets a narrow vote over the returning The Cistercian. Klitschko arrives on the back of 2 runner-up efforts and should also be on the premises.

  1. WILD GOOSE (IRE)
  2. THE CISTERCIAN (IRE)
  3. KLITSCHKO

races.name: 2027 Annual Badge At Tramore Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
A good opportunity for Triumph Hurdle sixth FORTY FIFTY to get off the mark on his return. Global Submission is the danger, with Flooring Brandy, a full brother to the classy Flooring Porter, well worth a look on debut.

  1. FORTY FIFTY (FR)
  2. GLOBAL SUBMISSION
  3. FLOORING BRANDY (IRE)

races.name: New Years Day Discount Tickets Online Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
EVEN THO couldn't have been much more impressive when landing a Grade 3 bumper at Punchestown in April and can make the most of an excellent opportunity sent hurdling en route to much better things. Lucky Valley is fancied to pip Ma Lumiere and Howyasox to the forecast spot with the longer trip in her favour.

  1. EVEN THO (IRE)
  2. LUCKY VALLEY (IRE)
  3. MA LUMIERE (IRE)

races.name: Book A Table For New Years Day Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WESTIN PIMPERNEL still looked a work in progress when gaining a first win for Gordon Elliott at Punchestown and can defy a 7 lb weights rise to go 2-3 since joining her new yard. Handicap debutant Dromana Mist rates the obvious danger in her hat-trick bid, while Leading Rose, Miss Lia and Mastertown Miss all need factoring in too.

  1. WESTIN PIMPERNEL (IRE)
  2. DROMANA MIST (IRE)
  3. LEADING ROSE (IRE)

races.name: Bill Halley Outstanding Contribution Award 2026 Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
A few with chances but THE DUCKS WALK signalled he is ready to go in again when an excellent runner-up in a big-field handicap at Punchestown recently so gets the vote. Johnny Cakes didn't enjoy the rub of the green when third at Limerick last time and rates a big threat off a handy-looking mark, while El Arco and Talas Kera appeal as the pick of the rest for minor honours.

  1. THE DUCKS WALK (IRE)
  2. JOHNNY CAKES (FR)
  3. EL ARCO (IRE)

races.name: 2027 Group Package Deals Online Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
REBEL REBA could only manage second when odds on for a maiden hurdle at Fairyhouse recently but a point win at the start of her career suggests she's worth another chance now chasing. Gavin Cromwell has won this 3 times since 2021 so his Naas handicap hurdle winner Let's Go Mans rates a possible danger. Walk In The Clouds has a profile which suggests she should take to chasing, while Kimy has placed in similar events this autumn.

  1. REBEL REBA (IRE)
  2. LET'S GO MANS (FR)
  3. WALK IN THE CLOUDS (IRE)

races.name: Ladies Cove Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
There is more to come from NOTIMELIKEDPRESENT and he gets the vote in the hope he's ready to go on his first start for 9 months. Stily can go well again, while Another Ocana lurks on a dangerous mark back up in trip.

  1. NOTIMELIKEDPRESENT (IRE)
  2. STILY (FR)
  3. ANOTHER OCANA (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
This doesn't look the strongest of bumpers, so LADY AURORA makes obvious appeal having joined Willie Mullins after running out an easy winner on her completed start in points. Found It should be capable of building on her opening effort under Rules at Punchestown in early-May, while Shuil Solas bumped into a good prospect on her penultimate outing and merits respect back in calmer waters.

  1. LADY AURORA (FR)
  2. FOUND IT (IRE)
  3. SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
